{{Quote|Luke Skywalker&hellip; File: ZC-1905-FT, Section: OC-6492, Human: 10th Degree, Born: Sidereal Era, AS-5670&hellip; of Master and Mistress Tan Skywalker on&mdash;|Mistress Mnemos|<ref name="The Constancia Affair">"[[The Constancia Affair]]"</ref>}}
'''ZC-1905-FT''' was the name of a file that the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]-owned [[BRT supercomputer/Legends|BRT supercomputer]] [[Mistress Mnemos]] utilized by [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fusai/Legends|Fusai]]. It contained the identities of various high-level members of the Rebel Alliance. It possessed at least one section, OC-6492, which gave details on the Alliance member [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. Mnemos attempted to quote the file for C-3PO before the latter told her that he was sent to supply details on the kind of person Luke Skywalker was that wasn't in the file already.
